concept: A gentle young elephant whose non-verbal sound vocabulary is emotionally readable across languages.
coreRule: Jabu never needs human-language dialogue in the core format. His recurring sounds should be recognisable from episode to episode.
productionApproach: Start from ethically sourced or newly recorded elephant-like tonal material, original synthesis, or a rights-cleared combination.
Layer soft breath, low resonant tone and small playful upper harmonics for warmth.
Keep sounds friendly and compact so they fit dialogue timing.
Do not use distress calls, aggressive trumpeting or sounds likely to frighten preschool viewers for comedy.

cues.shape: soft low prrr rising into a rounded oo
rising pitch ending in a gentle question contour
short bright puff/trumpet with soft tail
breathy tickle build, compact sneeze, tiny recovery puff
warm long call that falls gently at the end

technical.processing: deliver both dry and lightly designed versions
technical.loudness: leave healthy headroom; final programme loudness is handled in mastering

rights: Every source layer must have documented rights compatible with worldwide streaming, broadcast, apps, promotional clips and localisation.
